Koya 2023 (PMID 36458900, epub 2022-12-02) abstract quote verbatim. ASP6294 320 mg SC q4w per EU CTR 2016-004138-12: drug, route sc correct. Opener untested at 2016 proxy stands; its retrodiction flag (false) differs from entry 5 on the same model, no status effect.

EU CTR 2016-004138-12 results (first posted 2020-02-08) primary MMRM P=0.591, LS mean -0.2 verbatim. Model first public 2022, after tanezumab 2011 and ASP6294 2020 IC results: retrodiction; failed to reproduce, so contra. ASP6294, sc, women-only coded unselected: fine.
Koya 2023 abstract edema quote verbatim. ASP6294, route sc correct; opener untested at 2016 proxy stands.

Quote verbatim in Koya 2023 discussion (PMC9721442 full text). EU CTR: SAEs 0/56 vs 3/61, posted 2020-02-08, before the 2022 model: safety retrodiction on ASP6294's own result that reproduced it: retro. Claim is global tolerability, low confidence apt.
LaBranche 2017 (PMID 27381034, epub 2016-07-05) objective sentence verbatim. Tanezumab iv and IC population (imported-harm ruling) correct; opener untested 2016 at model first use stands.

LaBranche abstract quote verbatim, though it is the model_src side, not src (Evans 2011). Tanezumab IV IC patients: no joint SAE (NCT00601484 checked). Retrodiction (after tanezumab's own 2010-11 results) failing to reproduce: contra, opposite, 2016, per rules as written.

Opener for chem-cystitis x fulranumab x sc; Dmitrieva 1997 quote verbatim. NCT01060254: JNJ-42160443 (fulranumab) 9 mg SC q28d; drug and route correct. Untested 1997 stands; listed after later entries of other tracks.

Wang 2017 (PMID 28056917, epub 2017-01-05) primary-endpoint quote verbatim; NCT01060254 terminated for the hold, no posted results; Europe PMC shows no earlier report, so 2017 is earliest public. Primary missed: contra; underpowered stop correctly in confidence.
Opener for chem-cystitis x ASP6294 x sc; Dmitrieva 1997 quote verbatim. Untested 1997; drug ASP6294, route sc match EU CTR 2016-004138-12.

EU CTR 2016-004138-12 quote verbatim (primary MMRM, P=0.591); results first posted 2020-02-08. 1997 model predates trial, not a retrodiction; contra 2020, ASP6294, sc correct. Women-only trial; unselected coding acceptable.

missing: Wang H et al. 2017, BMC Urol 17:2, doi:10.1186/s12894-016-0193-z (PMID 28056917, epub 2017-01-05): fulranumab 9 mg SC in IC/BPS (NCT01060254, n=31), primary endpoint LS mean difference -0.2 [-1.52, 1.10], not significant; no joint-related SAE. The draft says this trial ended 'with no results'; it belongs in efficacy entry 3's patient_trials (no status change: underpowered, already contra) and the note should be corrected.

ASP6294 is a PEGylated Fab' (MAbs 2023, PMID 36458900, doi:10.1080/19420862.2022.2149055); the EU CTR record 2016-004138-12 (first posted 2020-02-08, women only, P=0.591, -0.2 [90% CI -0.84, 0.43]) confirms the draft's patient_trials quote and shows the female subgroup Nickel 2016 flagged was not confirmed prospectively.
rule_questions: Dose table row 'reached, failed, abandoned -> dose contra, derived_from efficacy' (and 'reached, worked -> same'): does it apply when no model ever stated an exposure target for any member drug? The draft keeps dose untested while efficacy goes same then contra; the rules do not say whether 'target reached' can be scored without a stated target.

Engagement: can a model's functional readout (cystometric voiding frequency in CYP cystitis) count as a downstream PD readout when the human trial measured its counterpart (micturition frequency, unchanged in Evans 2011)? If yes, engagement would be contra 2011 at readout_tier downstream; the draft scored it as a symptom endpoint.

Dating of efficacy entry 3: could not open the ClinicalTrials.gov history for NCT00999518 (API returned non-JSON). If the termination-for-interim-analysis text was public before Feb 2012, the year should be earlier; the rules do not say whether a registry termination reason without results counts as a public comparison.

Safety 2 and 6 (imported-harm ruling): IC patients set the status, but the only IC IV data are a single 200 ug/kg dose in 34 patients over 8 weeks. The rules do not say whether such exposure can test a rare, OA-joint harm (RPOA), i.e. whether no serious joint event there makes the tox package 'same' and the rat MMT model 'contra, opposite', or leaves both untested (not_measured).

Track openers: efficacy 6 and 8 add 1997 openers listed after 2022 entries, while efficacy 3's judgement says the tanezumab x sc track gets no opener because that would break year order. The rules do not say whether every track needs its own opener or whether cell-level year order governs.
